summary: Inventiva S.A. files a Form 6-K furnishing a press release disclosing preliminary financial results for H1 2026, including cash and cash equivalents of €166.1M plus €67.8M in short-term deposits as of June 30, 2026. The release references a comprehensive capital structure optimization announced on June 2, 2026, comprising a €103M equity offering and €75M debt financing, alongside repayment of an EIB loan and warrant repurchases. However, this 6-K is a routine financial update reporting past transactions, not a new special-situation event. The filing does not announce a new acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is a standard periodic report with no material event triggering classification.
